heads.en: Kyohua's old dream: The re-emergence of the homophages, tastes and trans-oceanic friendships in the 2026/11/17 prelude: the "unemployment" on the testimonial and the old retrospect in Beijing in August 1914. How long has it been since Beijing? When the plane landed at the airport in the capital, I consciously touched the testimonials that came with me. Over the last decade or so, I've been wrapped in a public service package and a tight agenda. This time, I was no longer a traveler for which meeting I had no job, but a simple "little Taipei" with a few parts and curiosity, trying to find the lost years of the city between the wads and the towers. heads.t: 古月獅子頭 2026/11/17 某日約金門文藝總編輯前往詩人古月府上，請教名菜「古月獅子頭」做法。古月詩人似寫一首好詩般娓娓道來： 材料：上胛夾心肉、荸薺、薑末、蔥末、胡椒粉、蛋、鹽、糖、醬油、麻油、太白粉少許、水、蛤蜊、皇帝豆。 作法：（一）所有材料攪拌，醒六十分鐘（放冰箱），捏成小拳頭大小來回拍三十下。裹一層薄太白粉，再放油鍋裡炸成金黃色撈起。 （二）準備一些肉皮切小塊。油熱了放少許碎冰糖。再放醬油，待冰糖融化，加豬皮，放獅子頭，滾了加酒燜熱二分鐘左右，加水淹過獅子頭，火滾小火慢燉。一小時後放蛤蜊大火收汁。收汁前二十分鐘加皇帝豆。…
